subject: Defining outcome thresholds, tie-breakers, and fallthrough plan for MAP
messages:
From: Clayton Moore <clayton@medisys.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Shah <anika.shah@healthlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — need clear pass/fail thresholds

Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked the latency/cost profile but our clinical team wants a concrete set of pass/fail checks we can take to procurement. Specifically they asked for:

- Minimum model concordance vs our gold set (top-1 accuracy on named-entity extraction)
- End-to-end token latency at 95th percentile under our expected load profile
- Data retention & audit log guarantees for trial data

Can you send a short proposal that maps each of those to acceptance thresholds and a fallback plan if we miss them? We need something to attach to the MSA review on Thursday.

Also tagging Anika from Clinical — she’ll own the gold-set validation.

Best,
Clayton

--
Clayton Moore
Director, Product Innovation
Medisys Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Clayton Moore <clayton@medisys.io>, Anika Shah <anika.shah@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — need clear pass/fail thresholds

Clayton / Anika —

Appreciate the clear ask. I attached a short KPI matrix (MAP_Success_KPIs_v1.xlsx) and a one-page fallthrough runbook. High-level proposal below; the spreadsheet has specifics that Priyom and I will validate against your gold set once Anika sends it.

Proposed acceptance thresholds (first pass):
1) Clinical concordance: >= 92% top-1 F1 on your annotated gold-set (sample size: 2k records)
2) Latency: P95 end-to-end <= 480ms at expected concurrency (baseline traffic profile attached)
3) Token cost: average per-1000-token inference cost <= $0.85 in Dedicated pool during trial
4) Data guarantees: 30-day retention for trial inputs, audit logs with per-request hashes and TTL review

Tie-breakers / weighting: concordance (40%), latency (25%), cost (20%), operational (15%).

Fallthrough play (if a threshold fails):
- If concordance misses by <= 2 points: enable conservative reranking + prompt augmentation and re-run batch validation; schedule a weekend re-eval with updated prompt set.
- If concordance misses by > 2 points: roll back to the verified smaller model variant and pause ramp until clinical sign-off; credit applied pro-rata for time in trial.
- If latency exceeds SLO: switch to a higher priority routing policy (burst pool) and enable KV prefix caching; allow a one-week remediation window before declaring failure.
- If cost overrun: throttle non-critical routes and enable quantized variant for non-clinical tokens.

Next steps I suggest:
- Anika: deliver gold-set link (or attach sample) by EOD Wed so Priyom can run the initial concordance pass.
- Priyom: I’ll schedule a short smoke run and share a trace log.
- Clayton: confirm whether the procurement team needs a specific wording for the MSA attachment (we can provide a 1-paragraph acceptance clause).

I’ll follow up with the annotated KPI sheet and a suggested MSA paragraph.

Thanks —
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@healthlytics.com>, Clayton Moore <clayton@medisys.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff — need clear pass/fail thresholds

Anika / team —

Thanks — I pulled a 2k-sample scaffold we can use for the gold-set validation. A few engineering notes before we lock numbers:

- Concordance measurement: we’ll run three runs: (a) baseline open model, (b) tuned prompt set, (c) tuned prompt + calibrated reranker. The acceptance threshold should reference the post-tuning result.
- Statistical power: 2k samples gives ~1% margin at 95% confidence for the F1 difference; we can expand to 5k if clinical variance is high.
- Latency testing: we need your expected concurrency pattern (p95 bursts vs steady). We can simulate with our Dedicated profile; P95 480ms is achievable on our 80/20 token mix but requires prefix caching.

I’ve added inline comments in MAP_Success_KPIs_v1.xlsx. I’ll also drop a minimal test harness (fallthrough_runbook.md) that outlines the steps and owners for any remediation.

Marissa — can you draft the acceptance test checklist for the clinical validation and the operational smoke tests? Aim for short, executable steps (<= 8 checks).

Thanks,
Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Clayton Moore <clayton@medisys.io>, Anika Shah <anika.shah@healthlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — need clear pass/fail thresholds

All —

Draft acceptance test checklist below (I attached the same into the MAP spreadsheet under the "AcceptanceTests" tab):

Clinical acceptance tests (owner: Anika / Medisys)
- 1) Run gold-set (2k) through tuned pipeline -> report top-1 F1 >= 92% (pass/fail)
- 2) Spot-check 20 edge-case notes (hand review) with >= 90% human agreement
- 3) No clinically unsafe hallucination observed in 500 sampled prompts

Operational smoke tests (owner: Priyom / Redwood infra)
- 1) P95 end-to-end latency <= 480ms under trial profile (3 runs)
- 2) KV prefix caching warms within 30 minutes for bulk replays
- 3) Audit log shows immutable per-request hash and request metadata stored for 30 days

Integration checks (owner: Laura Bennett)
- 1) Webhook retries idempotent for duplicate deliveries
- 2) Feature-flag gate present for canary traffic

Remediation timeline / owners
- T0 (immediate): if a safety issue (hallucination) is flagged -> stop ramp and invoke safety review (Anika + Redwood safety team)
- T+48h: if concordance misses <= 2 points -> implement prompt augmentation and re-run; owner: Priyom
- T+7d: if latency misses -> enable burst routing and caching; owner: Redwood infra (Vivek oversees)
- T+14d: if unresolved -> executive escalation and go/no-go decision point (Clayton + Vivek + Redwood VP eng)

I kept checks tight so procurement can sign off quickly. If everyone is aligned I’ll publish this checklist to the shared drive and add the DocuSign attachment language suggested by Vivek.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Clayton Moore <clayton@medisys.io>, Anika Shah <anika.shah@healthlytics.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — need clear pass/fail thresholds

Thanks team — quick sync notes and confirmation for procurement:

1) Finalized thresholds (as per spreadsheet): Clinical F1 >= 92% (2k sample), P95 latency <= 480ms, token cost <= $0.85/1k tokens, 30-day immutable audit logs.
2) Acceptance tests: use the AcceptanceTests tab (short checklist) as the MSA attachment; procurement requested exact wording — see paragraph below for insertion.
3) Fallthrough and credits: if Concordance misses by >2 points after remediation window, Redwood to provide a prorated credit for trial period and retain the option to revert to the verified model variant until clinical sign-off.

Suggested MSA paragraph for insertion (procurement-friendly):
"Acceptance: The parties agree that the Trial shall be deemed successful if the Clinical concordance (top-1 F1 on the mutually-agreed gold-set) is at least 92% and the P95 end-to-end latency at the agreed trial traffic profile is no greater than 480ms. If the Trial fails to meet these thresholds following the remediation timelines set out in the MAP, the parties will follow the Fallthrough Runbook to remediate. If remediation is unsuccessful within the prescribed windows, Redwood will provide a prorated credit for the Trial period and the parties will jointly decide whether to continue on a verified model variant."

Next immediate steps: Anika to share the gold-set link; Procurement at Medisys (Clayton) to include the above paragraph in the MSA and route for legal review. Priyom/Marissa will run the first validation as soon as we have the gold-set.

I uploaded the finalized MAP sheet and the runbook to the drive link in related_links and routed the DocuSign template for the MSA paragraph. If no objections, I’ll mark the MAP as "Ready for Procurement" tomorrow COB.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
